quests.instruction: What color is a ripe banana?
quests.hint: Sunflowers and the sun are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Bananas turn this bright color when they are ripe and ready to eat.
quests.funFact: A bunch of bananas is called a 'hand,' and each banana is a 'finger'!

quests.instruction: Look at the grass in the park. What color is it?
quests.hint: Frogs and fresh leaves are this color too!
quests.explanation: That's right! Fresh, healthy grass is this color.
quests.funFact: Grass gets its color from something inside it called chlorophyll!

quests.instruction: What color is a juicy apple?
quests.hint: Strawberries and cherries share this color!
quests.explanation: Great job! Many apples are this beautiful bright color.
quests.funFact: Apples float in water because they are about a quarter air!

quests.instruction: What color is the sky on a sunny day?
quests.hint: The ocean and a swimming pool are this color too!
quests.explanation: Correct! On a clear day, the sky looks this color.
quests.funFact: The sky looks this color because sunlight bounces off tiny bits of air!

quests.instruction: What color are sweet, juicy grapes?
quests.hint: Eggplants and ripe plums are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! These grapes are this lovely color.
quests.funFact: Grapes have been growing on Earth for millions of years!

quests.instruction: What color is a fresh orange you peel and eat?
quests.hint: Carrots and pumpkins are this color too!
quests.explanation: That's right! This fruit is actually where the color got its name!
quests.funFact: The color got its name from this fruit — not the other way around!

quests.instruction: What color is fresh snow in winter?
quests.hint: Clouds and a glass of milk are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Fresh snow is this bright, clean color.
quests.funFact: No two snowflakes have ever been found to look exactly the same!

quests.instruction: What color are a crow's feathers?
quests.hint: A top hat and a chalkboard are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! A crow's feathers are this deep, dark color all over.
quests.funFact: Crows are very clever birds that can even recognize human faces!

quests.instruction: What color is a piece of melted chocolate?
quests.hint: A teddy bear and a tree trunk are this color too!
quests.explanation: That's right! Chocolate is this warm, yummy color.
quests.funFact: Chocolate comes from the seeds of a cacao tree!

quests.instruction: What color is a ripe strawberry?
quests.hint: A fire truck and ripe cherries are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Ripe strawberries turn this color when they are ready to pick.
quests.funFact: Strawberries are the only fruit that wear their seeds on the outside!

quests.instruction: What color is a sour lemon?
quests.hint: A school bus and sweet corn are this color too!
quests.explanation: Correct! A ripe lemon is this bright, cheerful color.
quests.funFact: One lemon tree can grow over 500 lemons in a single year!

quests.instruction: What color is a frog sitting on a lily pad?
quests.hint: Grass and broccoli are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Many frogs are this color, which helps them hide among plants.
quests.funFact: A group of frogs is called an 'army'!

quests.instruction: What color is a flamingo standing in the water?
quests.hint: Bubblegum and cotton candy are this color too!
quests.explanation: That's right! Flamingos are famous for their bright feathers of this color.
quests.funFact: Flamingos are born gray — their feathers turn this color from the food they eat!

quests.instruction: What color is a small, round blueberry?
quests.hint: The sky and blue denim are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Blueberries are this deep, cool color.
quests.funFact: Blueberries are one of the very few foods that are naturally this color!

quests.instruction: What color is a big, round pumpkin?
quests.hint: A traffic cone and fresh carrots are this color too!
quests.explanation: Correct! Ripe pumpkins are this warm, bright color.
quests.funFact: The biggest pumpkins ever grown can weigh more than a small car!

quests.instruction: What color is a smooth, shiny eggplant?
quests.hint: Grapes and lavender flowers are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Eggplants have this deep, rich color.
quests.funFact: Eggplants are technically a fruit, not a vegetable!

quests.instruction: What color is a fluffy cloud on a sunny day?
quests.hint: Fresh snow and marshmallows are this color too!
quests.explanation: That's right! Fluffy clouds on a sunny day are this bright color.
quests.funFact: A fluffy cloud can weigh more than a million pounds — but it still floats!

quests.instruction: What color is a car tire?
quests.hint: A crow's feathers and burnt charcoal are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Tires are made this color to help them last a long time.
quests.funFact: The very first tires were actually white, not this color!

quests.instruction: What color is a cuddly teddy bear?
quests.hint: Melted chocolate and a coconut shell are this color too!
quests.explanation: Correct! Many teddy bears are made in this warm, cozy color.
quests.funFact: The teddy bear was named after a real American president!

quests.instruction: What color is a ripe tomato?
quests.hint: Apples and ladybugs are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! A ripe, juicy tomato turns this bright color.
quests.funFact: A tomato is actually a fruit, even though we eat it like a vegetable!

quests.instruction: What color are the petals of a tall sunflower?
quests.hint: Ripe bananas and lemons are this color too!
quests.explanation: That's right! Sunflower petals are this bright, sunny color.
quests.funFact: Sunflowers can grow taller than a grown-up in just one summer!

quests.instruction: What color is a fresh leaf on a tree in summer?
quests.hint: A hopping frog is this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Fresh summer leaves are this color.
quests.funFact: Leaves change color in autumn when they stop making their summer color!

quests.instruction: What color is the ocean on a clear day?
quests.hint: Denim jeans and a clear sky share this color!
quests.explanation: Correct! On a clear day, the ocean often looks this color.
quests.funFact: The ocean covers more than two-thirds of our whole planet!

quests.instruction: What color is bubblegum before you chew it?
quests.hint: A flamingo's feathers and a milkshake are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Classic bubblegum is this fun, bright color.
quests.funFact: The biggest bubblegum bubble ever blown was wider than a basketball hoop!

quests.instruction: What color is an old school chalkboard?
quests.hint: A car tire and a grand piano are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Traditional chalkboards are this dark color, perfect for white chalk.
quests.funFact: Chalkboards used to be made from real pieces of dark slate rock!

quests.instruction: What color is a fresh glass of milk?
quests.hint: Snow and a sheep's wool are this color too!
quests.explanation: That's right! Fresh milk is this pure, bright color.
quests.funFact: A single cow can produce enough milk to fill over 200 glasses every day!

quests.instruction: What color is a crunchy carrot?
quests.hint: A basketball and a ripe pumpkin are this color too!
quests.explanation: Yes! Most carrots you eat are this bright color.
quests.funFact: Carrots used to be purple before people grew them to be this color!

quests.instruction: What color is a ripe, juicy plum?
quests.hint: An eggplant and grape juice are this color too!
quests.explanation: Correct! A ripe plum has this deep, rich color.
quests.funFact: Dried plums are known by a different name: prunes!

quests.instruction: What color is a sweet, ripe cherry?
quests.hint: A fire truck and juicy strawberries share this color!
quests.explanation: Yes! Ripe cherries are this bright, cheerful color.
quests.funFact: Cherry trees can grow beautiful pink flowers before their fruit appears!

quests.instruction: What color are the kernels on an ear of corn?
quests.hint: The sun and a school bus are this color too!
quests.explanation: That's right! Sweet corn kernels are this bright color.
quests.funFact: One ear of corn usually has about 800 kernels, all in neat rows!
